products.body_html:
The Strength Kinect Mattress is designed with your comfort in mind, offering the perfect balance of support and softness. Featuring Duroflex’s signature 5-Zone Technology, it targets key areas of your body, providing optimal support where you need it most. 

This promotes better posture and helps you wake up feeling refreshed and energized. The adaptive memory foam quilting adds an extra layer of luxurious comfort, gently contouring to your body and offering relief from pressure points. It adjusts to your sleeping position, ensuring a personalized sleep experience that’s just right for you. 

Designed with strategically placed grooves, the Strength Kinect Mattress allows for better air circulation, keeping the surface cool and breathable throughout the night. Plus, it’s fully compatible with the Wave range of smart adjustable beds, so you can elevate your sleep experience and truly customize your comfort.

products.title: LiveIn 100% Latex Mattress
products.body_html:
Experience the perfect fusion of natural comfort and advanced support with the Duroflex LiveIn 100% Latex Mattress. Crafted with biodegradable natural latex and body-contouring memory foam, this mattress is designed to adapt to your body while ensuring a cool and breathable sleeping environment.
The 100% natural pincore latex layer provides exceptional support and pressure relief and promotes optimal spinal alignment. Additionally, its unique pincore structure enhances airflow and breathability, making it an ideal choice for hot sleepers. Paired with super soft foam, the mattress offers a plush, cloud-like feel, cradling your body in comfort while relieving pressure points for uninterrupted relaxation.
Designed for even weight distribution, the mattress minimizes strain on key pressure points like your back, hips, and shoulders, ensuring a pain-free sleep, no matter your sleeping position. Encased in premium breathable fabric, it wicks away moisture and feels silky-smooth against your skin, enhancing your overall sleep experience.
With a premium design and an emphasis on comfort, durability, and breathability, the Duroflex LiveIn 100% Latex Mattress redefines luxury sleep.
